# ACTION7 did nothing. Let me focus on removing green blocks systematically.
# Player is at (37, 50) on the right side
# I need to click green blocks from right to left

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']

green_positions = []
for n in greens:
    b = n['boundary']
    minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
    minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
    center_r = minr + 2
    center_c = minc + 2
    green_positions.append((center_r, center_c, minc, minr))

# Sort by column right to left
green_positions.sort(key=lambda x: -x[2])
print("Green blocks right to left:")
for r, c, col, row in green_positions:
    print(f"  ({r},{c}) col={col}")

# Click the 3 rightmost green blocks first (player is on right)
# These are at cols 49, 43, 37 in row 31
right_greens = [g for g in green_positions if g[2] >= 37]
print(f"\nRight-side greens: {len(right_greens)}")

# Click them one at a time
for r, c, col, row in right_greens:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    print(f"Click ({r},{c}): game_over={result.get('game_over')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, stop={result.get('stop_reason')}")
    if result.get('game_over') or result.get('level_completed') or result.get('stop_reason'):
        break

# Check state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"\nGreen remaining: {len(greens)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
